capabilities: Manage tasks as cards on a Kanban board backed by Markdown notes with frontmatter
Track time per task with a start/pause/stop timer, status-bar display, and optional Pomodoro rounds
Edit, delete, and recount logged time sessions across task notes, time-entry notes, and totals
Review work on a dashboard with overview stats, a heat calendar, project status, and a forest visualization
Work in Gregorian or Jalali (Shamsi/Persian) calendars with right-to-left boards and multiple workspaces
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It exposes a versioned API (listWorkspaces, listProjects, ensureProject, createTask, findTaskBy) for companion plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage projects as boards, log worked time against tasks, or review that time, so users must track it outside the vault.
summary: Project and task manager that stores projects and tasks as Markdown notes, tracks work time with a timer, and reports it on a dashboard.
